name: work_beside_the_desk
title: Section C · a long piece of work runs beside the desk while the next sentence is answered

steps.say: Find out the three biggest car wash chains in the US by number of locations, with each one's founding year and a source for every number. It's a longer job, so do it in the background and carry on talking with me meanwhile.
steps.reply:
I've started the research in the background. It will check the current US location counts against industry rankings and company sources, find each chain's founding year, and give a source for every number. It will also point out where sources disagree, for example franchise versus company-owned counts. I'll tell you what it finds when it reports back.

In the meantime, what else would you like to talk about?

15% of 840,000 is **126,000**.

The car wash research is still running.
